title: chore: unify all package versions to 2.0.5
body:
`@objectstack/plugin-auth` was at `2.0.3` while all other packages were at `2.0.4` — it was missing from the changeset fixed versioning group and fell behind.

- **`.changeset/config.json`**: Added `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` to the `fixed` group so all 20 packages always version-lock together
- **Version bump**: Patch release `2.0.5` across all packages via `pnpm changeset version`
- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: Added 2.0.5 entry

Before:
```
2.0.4  @objectstack/spec
2.0.4  @objectstack/core
2.0.3  @objectstack/plugin-auth   ← out of sync
2.0.4  @objectstack/plugin-security  ← not in fixed group
```

After: all `@objectstack/*` packages at `2.0.5`, fixed group covers every package.
